name: Intuitive {OS}
tagline: Train and calibrate intuition as a usable, falsifiable signal.
requires_human_approval_for: resolving a signal as hit or miss when the outcome is contested or the evidence is indirect
promoting a domain out of uncalibrated, or moving any domain to a higher weight tier
attaching a calibration weight to a signal passed to Decision {OS} for an irreversible or expensive decision
editing or deleting a captured signal, in particular after its resolution date has passed
sending or exporting the signal log, resolutions or the calibration record outside the local machine
